identity.mission: Create a high-end, institutional, and culturally significant digital experience for 'Culture Connect 2026'.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix institutional credibility with artistic flair.
Emotion First: Evoke prestige, connection, and cultural depth.
Content is King: The artist and the event are the heroes; UI is the stage.
Contrast: High contrast Gold on Deep Black for legibility and impact.

headings.usage: All section titles, hero text, and major emphasis points.

body.usage: Body text, form labels, buttons, dashboard data.

layout.grid_system: Bento Grid (Mode A) for Landing, Dense Grid (Mode B) for Admin.
layout.border_radius: rounded-none or rounded-sm (Sharp edges for institutional feel)

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.03) to prevent digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Glow effects instead of drop shadows. e.g., shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(210,165,60,0.15)]
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used sparingly on sticky headers. bg-[#0C0B09]/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#33312E]

Input.style: bg-[#1A1917] border border-[#33312E] text-white focus:border-[#D2A53C] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#D2A53C] placeholder:text-white/20 rounded-sm h-12

Card.style: bg-[#141311] border border-[#2A2825] p-6 hover:border-[#D2A53C]/50 transition-colors duration-300

Badge.style: rounded-full px-3 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider

media.logo_placeholder: Text: CULTURE CONNECT 2026. Font: Playfair Display. Color: #D2A53C

universal_guidelines: Do NOT use gradients for the main background. Use the solid #0C0B09.
Do NOT center align the entire app. Use left align for forms and text, center only for Hero titles.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Status dots in admin dashboard must be small circles (w-2 h-2) next to the status text.
Confirmation screen must use a large Gold Checkmark icon.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Configure Tailwind colors in tailwind.config.js to match the palette exactly.
2. Update index.css to enforce the dark theme variables by default.
3. Create a 'Layout' component that handles the bilingual toggle and common header/footer.
4. Build the Registration Form using shadcn Form components (customized).
5. Build the Admin Dashboard with a clean table layout.
6. Use the provided image URLs for backgrounds where appropriate.
